_provenance.dataset: IDSSE / Sportec Open DFL dataset (2022/23 Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga)
_provenance.attribution: Deutsche Fussball Liga (DFL); Bassek et al., Scientific Data (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y
_provenance.method: xPass: logistic regression (Newton, L2 penalty on coefficients); features from event locations and the nearest 5 Hz tracking frame. xG: the simulator's model (xg.coefficients)
_provenance.note: Coefficients and fit summaries only; no real event or tracking rows.

xg.coefficients: the simulator's: shotModel.xg in data/params/touchline-params.json under shotModel.rule 1 (the fractional logit on DFL model xG, touchline_analytics.shots.fit_xg), read through sim-core xgCoefs
